_comment: Channels of every new-api (prod and stg alike; AI-models DESIGN §7.2). Create with scripts/newapi_admin.py apply-channels; the LiteLLM key comes from --key-file / --key-env and is never stored here. "models" names a list in pricing-plan.json. Change this file (and re-run apply-channels --update, then verify-settings), not the console.
_comment_free: free = the self-hosted Qwen trial (GroupRatio.free 0, D11). It must serve only pricing-plan.json "local", and those models must never sit in a paid group: a model in group free is free for everyone (verify-settings checks both through /api/pricing). The reverse holds too: a model with ModelRatio 0 is free in a paid group as well, so paid channels serve only priced models (pricing-plan.json "unpriced" stays out; checked offline and live). param_override caps max_tokens (starting point 2048; tune after the NA-08 load test).
